name: VMware ESX
about: The newest ESX (ESXi) release on each line. Each one fixes every ESX bug we cover, except where a fix is listed as pending below; Broadcom's patches are cumulative.

unfixed.note: Broadcom lists the 9.0 fix for CVE-2026-123914 and CVE-2026-123915 as patch pending.
Broadcom lists no public fix; customers with an extended support contract are told to contact Broadcom Support.

sources.title: Broadcom VMSA-2026-0011: fixed ESX builds per line, 9.0 patch pending for two moderate bugs
Broadcom: VMSA-2026-0011 Q&A, ESX wasn't in VMSA-2026-0009, patches are cumulative

older: VMware Cloud Foundation 5.x: patch ESX to 8.0 U3m through Broadcom's asynchronous patching guide (KB 88287), or move all of VCF to 5.2.5, including ESX; updating SDDC Manager alone doesn't update ESX.
